first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ. The durable memory shows that signup simplification (memory_31) and shortening onboarding (memory_86) both improved early adoption metrics. These interventions are complementary and address the immediate declining metrics. I'm verifying the two most directly relevant memories to confirm the effect sizes and any boundary conditions before committing. Promotional pricing targets a different segment (price-sensitive SMBs responding to competitor threat) but may not address the core activation problem. Referral incentives work well with established customers but we have an immediate activation crisis. Enterprise sales assist is valuable but doesn't address the self-serve activation decline. A simplified onboarding test at standard scale can run quickly and directly addresses both reported declines while preserving the referral and enterprise channels for future allocation.
